sn36.7:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
sn36.7:1.2: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena gilānasālā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
sn36.7:2.1: sato bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno kālaṃ āgameyya
sn36.7:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn36.7:3.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn36.7:3.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sato hoti.
sn36.7:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī hoti gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
sn36.7:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajānakārī hoti.
sn36.7:4.4: sato bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno kālaṃ āgameyya
sn36.7:5.1: tassa ce bhikkhuno evaṃ satassa sampajānassa appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati sukhā vedanā so evaṃ pajānāti
sn36.7:5.2: uppannā kho me ayaṃ sukhā vedanā
sn36.7:5.3: sā ca kho paṭicca no appaṭicca
sn36.7:5.6: ayaṃ kho pana kāyo anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno
sn36.7:5.7: aniccaṃ kho pana saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kāyaṃ paṭicca uppannā sukhā vedanā kuto niccā bhavissatīti.
sn36.7:5.8: so kāye ca sukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassī viharati vayānupassī viharati virāgānupassī viharati nirodhānupassī viharati paṭinissaggānupassī viharati.
sn36.7:5.9: tassa kāye ca sukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassino viharato vayānupassino viharato …pe… paṭinissaggānupassino viharato yo kāye ca sukhāya ca vedanāya rāgānusayo so pahiyyati.
sn36.7:6.1: tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃ satassa sampajānassa appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati dukkhā vedanā
sn36.7:6.4: sā ca kho paṭicca no appaṭicca
sn36.7:6.7: ayaṃ kho pana kāyo anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno
sn36.7:6.8: aniccaṃ kho pana saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kāyaṃ paṭicca uppannā dukkhā vedanā kuto niccā bhavissatīti.
sn36.7:6.9: so kāye ca dukkhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassī viharati vayānupassī viharati virāgānupassī viharati nirodhānupassī viharati paṭinissaggānupassī viharati.
sn36.7:6.10: tassa kāye ca dukkhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassino viharato …pe… paṭinissaggānupassino viharato yo kāye ca dukkhāya ca vedanāya paṭighānusayo so pahiyyati.
sn36.7:7.1: tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃ satassa sampajānassa appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā so evaṃ pajānāti
sn36.7:7.3: sā ca kho paṭicca no appaṭicca
sn36.7:7.6: ayaṃ kho pana kāyo anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno
sn36.7:7.7: aniccaṃ kho pana saṅkhataṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kāyaṃ paṭicca uppannā adukkhamasukhā vedanā kuto niccā bhavissatīti.
sn36.7:7.8: so kāye ca adukkhamasukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassī viharati vayānupassī viharati virāgānupassī viharati nirodhānupassī viharati paṭinissaggānupassī viharati.
sn36.7:7.9: tassa kāye ca adukkhamasukhāya ca vedanāya aniccānupassino viharato …pe… paṭinissaggānupassino viharato yo kāye ca adukkhamasukhāya ca vedanāya avijjānusayo so pahiyyati.
sn36.7:8.1: so sukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati sā aniccāti pajānāti anajjhositāti pajānāti anabhinanditāti pajānāti
sn36.7:8.3: adukkhamasukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati sā aniccāti pajānāti anajjhositāti pajānāti anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn36.7:8.4: so sukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto naṃ vedayati
sn36.7:8.5: dukkhañce vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto naṃ vedayati
sn36.7:8.6: adukkhamasukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati visaññutto naṃ vedayati.
sn36.7:8.7: so kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti
sn36.7:8.8: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantīti pajānāti.
sn36.7:9.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave telañca vaṭṭiñca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya
sn36.7:9.2: tasseva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā anāhāro nibbāyeyya.
sn36.7:9.3: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ce kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti. jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti.
sn36.7:9.4: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītibhavissantīti pajānātīti.
